entries.message: Removed the setup look choices and look storage queries that nothing uses since setup's overhaul, and the unused iCloud sync status query.
Messages only the core sends itself no longer cross the wire, engine registration keeps only the capabilities an engine supports, and test-only JSON entry points moved into the tests.
Removed shared code nothing uses: an old setup page, unused design tokens, branding and identity helpers, a widget scope no one reads, and search sheet presentation.
Removed Mac setup code the overhaul left unused, permission fields nothing reads, and kept preview-only fixtures out of release builds.
Removed the iPhone sidebar's new-tab prompt, which no layout ever showed.
Removed empty test classes and unused test helpers, old app-icon sources, an unused fixture corpus, a broken icon script, an empty test scheme and catalog strings no code uses.
